objective_value: <float> Total expected cost combining fixed hub setup costs and the probability-weighted sum of collection, distribution, and inter-hub transfer costs across all demand scenarios.
hubs: <list[int]> Indices of nodes chosen to operate as hubs.
allocations: <dict, key: '{scenario}'> For each scenario, a mapping from every node to the hub it is served by under that scenario; a hub node is mapped to itself. Inner dict has key: '{node}' with integer value giving the index of the assigned hub.
z_values: <list[float], length n> For each node, an indicator of whether that node is opened as a hub (1 = opened, 0 = not opened).
x_values: <dict, key: '{scenario}'> For each scenario, the spoke-to-hub assignment pattern. Inner dict has key: '{origin_node}' mapping to a dict with key: '{candidate_hub}' (excluding the origin itself) and float value indicating whether the origin node is assigned to that candidate hub in that scenario (1 = assigned, 0 = not assigned).
